notes: p141 continues p140 (+); p143 and p144 continue the previous page (+). p144: a waqf sign ۚ (ج) is printed at the opening bracket before «كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ» (Tanzil has it after the preceding word «لِلْكُتُبِ», outside this quotation); kept as ﴿ۚ كَمَا…. p141: no waqf sign printed after «رَمَىٰ» (Tanzil has ۚ). Many words print only one kasra on «آلِه», «حَوْلِه», «وَقُوَّتِه», «مُرَاقَبَتِه», «سُلْطَانِك» (kasra under the letter before final ه/ك only) — transcribed as printed. Stacked mark (sukun over fatha/damma) over lam+next letter read as sukun on lam + vowel on the next letter (e.g. الْمَتِينِ); on p142 first «وَالأَفْعَالِ» the lam has no separate sukun (the stack sits on the hamza: fatha + sukun of ف), unlike the later «وَالْأَفْعَالِ». «وبَارِكْ» printed without fatha on و except in no.63 (وَبَارِكْ). «استجابَ» (p144) printed without harakat except final fatha.
